lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance, roughly circular clusters arranged in a repetitive grid-like formation posterior to the gill slits. The highest intensity maxima are distributed in parallel horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a lattice-like appearance where blobs frequently occupy the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature is visible running horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and a corresponding shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple dark, elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (commensal fish) are visible trailing beneath the primary pectoral fin structure.
